gui.super_snowmen.hint.pumpkin: Add pumpkins to increase attack speed by 4% each
gui.super_snowmen.hint.snow: Add snow blocks to increase maximum health by 2 each
gui.super_snowmen.hint.diamond: Up to 4 diamonds; each adds +1 projectile damage and one layer of Protection reduction
gui.super_snowmen.hint.ice_generic: Add a full stack of different ice blocks for different defensive effects
gui.super_snowmen.hint.packed_ice: Packed Ice: Climate and Drowning Immunity, +10 Armor (requires 64)
gui.super_snowmen.hint.blue_ice: Blue Ice: Climate and Drowning Immunity, +15 Armor, +5 Toughness (requires 64)
gui.super_snowmen.guide.title: Projectile Upgrade Guide
gui.super_snowmen.guide.spectral_arrow: Fires a spectral arrow that marks its target as glowing.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.fire_charge: Fires a blaze fireball and grants the snow golem Fire Resistance.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.firework_rocket: Fires a damaging crossbow-style rocket with randomized explosions.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.dragon_breath: Fires dragon breath and makes the snow golem immune to dragon breath.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.tnt: Launches block-safe TNT and makes the snow golem immune to explosions.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.wither_skull: Fires wither skulls; grants Wither immunity, kill healing, and a projectile force field.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.sculk_shrieker: Emits a sonic boom that damages its target and other monsters along the beam.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.totem: Summons a line of evoker fangs toward the target.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.tipped_arrow: Fires any equipped tipped arrow and preserves its potion effects.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.potion: Throws any equipped regular or splash potion and preserves its effects.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.splash_potion: Throws the equipped splash potion with its original effects.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.egg: Throws an egg, grants Cluck and Slow Falling, and periodically lays eggs like a chicken.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.trident: Throws the equipped trident and preserves Impaling and Channeling.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.shulker_shell: Fires a homing shulker bullet, grants high armor, and grants Levitation immunity.
gui.super_snowmen.guide.lightning_rod: Only one may be installed; adds 5% Trident, and Channeling ignores weather requirements.
